sections.text_helper: Section 2.1.3 "S-bus" in chapter 2 (Memory and bus architecture), RM0522 Rev 1, page 89.
sections.section_content:
This bus connects the system bus of the Cortex-M33 core to the bus matrix. This bus is
used by the core to access data located in a peripheral or SRAM area. This bus targets the
internal SRAMs (SRAM1/2), the AHB1 peripherals (including APB1/2), AHB2, and AHB3
peripherals.
SRAM1 and SRAM2 are accessible on this bus with a continuous mapping.
